about_the_game:
This is the original soundtrack for "Clover Reset," a yuri visual novel game that will capture your heart at first sight.

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

"Hey, do you know the meaning of the four-leaf clover?"

This is a story of four girls, united by a four-leaf clover, growing together, supporting each other, and experiencing the unforgettable romance of youth.

The game centers on the theme "It's the differences that make us admire and fall for each other."

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
Through intertwining stories of girls with different backgrounds and personalities, "Clover Reset" is a yuri visual novel that explores themes of sweetness, moving emotions, and small surprises.

This soundtrack enhances the appeal of their story with gentle, hope-filled melodies. It captures the essence of youth, yuri, struggles, and hope, allowing these themes to resonate even more deeply.

Not only will it accompany you through gameplay, but each time you listen to it in your daily life, their story will come back to life vividly.

(The soundtrack is provided in high-quality WAV format.)

short_description: 「見た瞬間好きになる青春百合ノベルゲーム『Clover Reset』」オリジナルサウンドトラック。 甘さや感動、ちょっとした驚きを感じさせるエピソードの中で、青春、百合、葛藤、希望といったテーマがこのサウンドトラックから感じていただけると幸いです。 プレイ中だけでなく、日常の中でも聴くたびに、彼女たちの物語が鮮やかに蘇ることでしょう。
